title: Neology UK Ltd v Newcastle City Council
description: Neology challenged the award of an ANPR system contract to Siemens Mobility Ltd, alleging evaluation panel errors including unequal treatment and lack of transparency. The court dismissed a summary judgment application by the defendant authorities, holding Neology's criticisms were ordinary disagreements rather than evidence of breaches. The automatic suspension was lifted, allowing the Council to proceed with Siemens pending trial.
contracting_authority_name: The Council of the City of Newcastle Upon Tyne
